artifacts.summary: Wired verify-deploy.sh's --skip-slow flag into deploy-headless.sh's inline post-deploy verification with a new exit code 3, added a fixture-driven regression suite, documented the exit-3 contract and orchestrator collision, and demonstrated the ACCEPTANCE scenario end to end with three real deploy runs.

completion_data.completion_summary: Replaced deploy-headless.sh's echoed verify-deploy command with a real inline invocation (verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow) that exits 3 on failure, added the --skip-slow flag to verify-deploy.sh, a fixture-driven regression suite, and documented the exit-3 contract and the skill-orchestrate Stage MT-3 collision. Verified end-to-end with a deliberately injected line_count mismatch: deploy landed, verification failed, exit 3, no human verify-deploy invocation, and a clean revert.

memory_candidates.content: verify-deploy.sh's gate 3 (doc-lint) always invokes check-extension-docs.sh with --quiet internally, regardless of verify-deploy's own --quiet flag. Per-file finding text (e.g. a specific line_count mismatch) only surfaces when the CALLER passes verify-deploy's --findings flag, which re-parses the captured --quiet output for 'FAIL:' lines. A caller that wants a failing gate's specific broken-file detail in its own output must either pass --findings through, or the failure message must explicitly point the reader at the un-quieted re-run command (e.g. 'bash check-extension-docs.sh' with no --quiet) as the way to get detail.

Adding a new test file under agent-system/extensions/<ext>/scripts/tests/ is NOT sufficient by itself for it to deploy or pass verify-deploy.sh's gate 5 (manifest-driven declared-vs-deployed parity). It must also be registered in that extension's manifest.json under provides.scripts (e.g. 'tests/new-test.sh') -- the copy engine (loader.lua's copy_category) only copies files the manifest declares. Forgetting this registration produces a gate-5 'Missing scripts: scripts/tests/X.sh' finding on the very next full deploy, even though the file exists on disk and bash -n/standalone-run both pass.
